root_cause_title: Incommensurate Multi-Resolution Spatial Discretization, Unpreserved Boundary Surfaces, and Initial Phase Gravitational Slap

remediations_applied.implementation: pointref is set uniformly to (dp/2, dp/2, dp/2) for all tiers, aligning container boundaries with cell faces across resolutions.

remediations_applied.remediation: Elimination of Gravitational Drop Air Gap
remediations_applied.implementation: Fluid fill box is initialized continuously from the tank bottom boundary (z=0.0) up to z=0.482m with modefill=void. Eliminates the 0-35mm air gap and prevents the 39-110 J free-fall kinetic energy shock.
Boundary layer count increased to 4 (vdp=0,1,2,3), giving boundary thickness = 3*dp >= 2h (2h = 3.18*dp), preventing particle penetrations and corner deletions.
speedsound fixed explicitly to 65.23 m/s based on physical fluid height 0.482m, preventing resolution-dependent EOS compressibility.
